answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a digital mirror reflecting resource scarcity into the network, preventing Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital. Like a nebula of dispersed nodes forming a singular horizon of consensus, this mechanism ensures an attacker’s cost scales linearly with their influence. By tethering identity to staked tokens rather than ephemeral addresses, the system forces adversaries to exhaust substantial financial capital to achieve a majority, rendering malicious identity proliferation prohibitively expensive.
